pokedexEntries.ru: KYOGRE has the power to create massive rain clouds that cover the entire sky and bring about torrential downpours. This POKéMON saved people who were suffering from droughts.

pokedexEntries.sa: KYOGRE is named in mythology as the POKéMON that expanded the sea by covering the land with torrential rains and towering tidal waves. It took to sleep after a cataclysmic battle with GROUDON.

pokedexEntries.frlg: This POKéMON is said to have expanded the sea by bringing heavy rains. It has the power to control water.

pokedexEntries.em: KYOGRE has appeared in mythology as the creator of the sea. After long years of feuding with GROUDON, it took to sleep at the bottom of the sea.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

pokedexEntries.hgss: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with GROUDON.

pokedexEntries.bw: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

pokedexEntries.x: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.

pokedexEntries.y: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

pokedexEntries.or: Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can summon storms that cause the sea levels to rise.

pokedexEntries.as: Kyogre is said to be the personification of the sea itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Groudon, as each sought to gain the power of nature.
